label: Line 6 Bass POD Pro
note: Live MIDI CC control map for the Bass POD Pro (Line 6, "Fast Forward" / Yamaha, SysEx ID 00 01 0C, family 02 00). Every control below is a real-time control-change message on the POD's global MIDI channel; nothing here needs a SysEx dump. Values and names are taken from the cross-reference table in mapping/bass_pod_pro_mapping.ods, with the message envelope verified against mapping/Bass POD Pro Sysex - English .pdf.

programs.note: Internal programs 1A-9D. Program change 0 is Manual mode and PC 37 is the tuner - both are front-panel buttons on the hardware rather than memories.

sysexLayout.note: Where each parameter lives in the 80-byte program that a sys-ex dump carries. 'byte' and 'bits' are the Byte Addr. and MSb/LSb columns of the PROGRAM DATA table in mapping/Bass POD Pro Sysex - English .pdf; 'mode' says how the stored field becomes the control-change value this app speaks: 'value' = the stored field IS the value (the value tables are ordered that way), 'scale' = multiply by 'scale' (the POD stores most continuous parameters in 6 bits while their CC range runs 0-126, so stored * 2 = CC - which is exactly why 126 is the top of those ranges), 'bit' = a single on/off bit reported as offValue/onValue.

fields.note: CC 22 is a switch rather than a level (the PDF: received 0-63 = OFF, 64-127 = ON) and the gate's actual amount is a separate parameter with no control-change number, so the dump's on/off bit loads as the smallest on value.
The PDF gives no bit field for this byte, so the whole low 7 bits are used.

First byte of the effect parameter UNION (program bytes 53-59). Its meaning depends on the selected effect - see the EFFECT TYPE PARAMETER TABLE - so it is decoded for inspection only and the panel has no control for it.

controls.label: Amp Model
controls.title: The POD's amp model. 16 models (0-15), each one a Line 6 model of a real bass amp.

controls.label: Drive
controls.title: Input drive into the amp model. 0-126 (the POD's control-change range stops one short of 127).

controls.label: Bass
controls.title: Low shelf of the amp model's tone stack. 0-126.

controls.label: Middle
controls.title: Mid band of the amp model's tone stack. 0-126.

controls.label: Treble
controls.title: High shelf of the amp model's tone stack. 0-126.

controls.label: Channel Vol
controls.title: Volume of the selected amp channel. 0-126.

controls.label: Cabinet
controls.title: Speaker cabinet/mic model, right after the amp it goes with. The table is in the POD's own cabinet codes - 10 is Bypass (no cabinet) - which is also what a program dump stores in byte 31, so the cabinet a patch was saved with is the one selected here.

controls.label: AIR Level
controls.title: AIR level: a Line 6 cabinet 'air' control, 0 to +24 dB. There is no knob for it on the POD's front panel - it lives in the pedal's cabinet pages - and the pedal stores it in 6 bits, so it is 0-126 here (127 is accepted but is the same stored step as 126) and a patch dump reads back as double the stored value.

controls.label: Compress
controls.title: The POD's front-panel Compress knob: how much compression the compressor applies. It moves the compressor's level and threshold together - the separate threshold parameter (program byte 26) has no control-change number at all, so it can only ever be read from a patch dump.

controls.label: Ratio
controls.title: Compression ratio. The POD displays 2:1, 3.3:1, 8:1, 12:1 or Inf:1, with band edges at 0, 25, 50, 75 and 100 - but it is one continuous 0-127 control, and real patches store values in between (30, 104), so the knob sends exactly what it holds and the readout just names the band.

controls.label: Attack
controls.title: How fast the compressor clamps down. 0-127. The POD never reports this one - its sys-ex document marks the individual compressor parameters NO TRANSMIT - so it fills in from a patch dump and stays dimmed until then.

controls.label: Release
controls.title: How fast the compressor lets go - 'decay' in the POD's own documentation. 0-127, and like the rest of the compressor parameters it is never reported by the pedal, so it comes from a patch dump.

controls.label: Param Freq
controls.title: Centre frequency of the parametric band, 30Hz-8kHz. 0-126.

controls.label: Param Q
controls.title: Width of the parametric band. 0-126.

controls.label: Param Gain
controls.title: Cut/boost of the parametric band, -15dB to +24dB. 0-126.

controls.label: Mid Sweep
controls.title: Moves the amp model's mid-frequency centre. 0-126.

controls.label: Effect Select
controls.title: Which of the POD's 16 effects is loaded. This list is in the POD's own effect codes, not the order its knob cycles through them (Bypass is 10, Orange Phase is 0). A program dump stores the same code in byte 49, and a real dump agrees: the patch named 'Jaco clean chorus' stores 9, and 26 of that POD's 36 programs store 10 - Bypass.

controls.label: Effect Tweak
controls.title: The selected effect's main parameter. 0-126. CC 1 is the mod-wheel position on a general MIDI device; the POD simply uses it as this knob.

controls.label: FX Lo-Cut
controls.title: High-pass filter on the effect path, off to 1kHz. 0-126.

controls.label: Gate
controls.title: Noise gate on/off. This knob is 0-127 unlike the others because it is a switch: 0-63 is off and 64-127 is on. How hard the gate works is a separate parameter (threshold and decay are sys-ex-only on the POD, with no live control change).

controls.label: Dig Out Level
controls.title: Level of the POD's digital output. 0-126. This is a system-wide setting on the POD rather than part of an individual program.

controls.label: Apply FX to D.I.
controls.title: Whether the effects feed the D.I. output as well as the main outs. System-wide (0=off, 127=on), not part of an individual program.

controls.label: Manual
controls.title: Switches the POD to Manual mode - the front panel knobs control the sound directly instead of a stored program.

controls.label: Tuner
controls.title: Switches the POD to its tuner. Program change 37 is the tuner on this device.
